result.summary: All 64 rows were exact-paired candidate-disagreement states. Aggregate source-to-candidate continuation drift was -0.04727 bb/state; BB flop -0.2201 +/-0.4768, SB flop +0.0311 +/-0.0600, and both turn routes exactly zero. No candidate action margin changed from positive to nonpositive. BB-turn and SB-flop candidate choices were already negative on average under the source continuation target.
result.conclusion: Do not make candidate-continuation or multi-step conversion the next large training run, and do not scale the rejected capped-soft checkpoint.
result.next_step: A sequential intervention targets a different learned topology or demonstrates substantial candidate-continuation sign/ranking drift on a broader validated policy family; otherwise prioritize action-margin uncertainty, opponent disagreement and tail-risk calibration.
